name: Feedback Academy
description: Practice giving high-quality formative feedback on AI scenarios, then apply skills to real classmate work

intro.message:
Welcome to Feedback Academy! You'll practice giving effective formative feedback.

First: Practice on AI scenarios
Then: Give feedback to real classmates

Remember: Great feedback is specific, actionable, timely, and focused on improvement!

choose-topic.message:
Teacher: Choose what students will give feedback on this round.

Examples:
- A paragraph of writing
- A math problem solution
- A project idea
- A presentation outline
- A design sketch description

teacherInput.label: Enter the topic or item for feedback

practice-intro.message:
PRACTICE ROUND

You'll see an AI-generated scenario. Your job: Give high-quality formative feedback.

Focus on being:
✓ Specific (point to exact details)
✓ Actionable (suggest concrete next steps)
✓ Growth-oriented (help them improve)
✓ Balanced (strengths + areas to develop)

generate-scenarios.instruction: Generate 1 realistic student work scenario that needs feedback. It should be a plausible example of student work with both strengths and clear areas for improvement. Format as JSON object: {"id": 1, "work": "the student's work/response", "context": "what the assignment was"}. Make the work authentic to middle/high school level - not too polished, showing genuine student effort but with room to grow. The work sample should be 2-4 sentences long. Make it feel real - include minor errors, incomplete thoughts, or unclear explanations that feedback could address.

assign-scenarios.message:
Everyone will give feedback on this scenario.

Read carefully, then write feedback that would actually help this student improve!

coach-feedback.instruction: You are a friendly feedback coach helping students improve. Evaluate each student's feedback and rate it 1-100 based on how specific, actionable, and encouraging it is. For each student, return: {"playerId": "id", "score": 0-100, "strengths": "one thing they did really well in their feedback", "coaching": "one specific tip to make their feedback even better"}. Use friendly, encouraging language like you're coaching a friend, not writing a research paper. Be honest but kind.

real-intro.message:
REAL ROUND

Now apply what you learned!

Everyone will submit work, then you'll give feedback to a real classmate.

Remember:
✓ Be specific
✓ Be actionable
✓ Focus on growth
✓ Balance strengths + areas to develop

collect-work.prompt:
Submit your work for peer feedback.

(Teacher will specify what to submit based on the topic chosen earlier)

This will be shared anonymously with a classmate who will give you feedback.

show-work.message:
A classmate submitted:

"{{_current.text}}"

Your turn to give them helpful feedback!

give-feedback.prompt:
Give formative feedback on:

"{{_current.text}}"

Be specific, actionable, and constructive. Help them improve!

coach-real-feedback.instruction: You are an expert feedback coach. Evaluate the quality of each student's peer feedback using the same criteria as before: specificity, actionability, growth orientation, and balance. For each, return: {"playerId": "id", "score": 0-100, "strengths": "what improved from practice round", "coaching": "one key insight for next time"}. Compare to their practice round if possible - did they apply the coaching? Score generously for genuine effort and improvement. Return array of all evaluations.

show-feedback-received.message:
{{_current.playerName}}'s work:
"{{_current.text}}"

Received this feedback:
"[feedback text here]"

reflection.message:
Great work, Feedback Academy graduates!

Key takeaways:
• Specific > vague
• Actionable > judgmental
• Growth-focused > fixed
• Balanced > one-sided

Keep practicing these skills in all your peer feedback!

end.message: You've completed Feedback Academy! Use these skills to help your classmates grow.
